title: Satisfiability Equivalence for the Transformation
statement: Let $$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables, let $w$ be any natural number, and let $x$ be an assignment to its variables. The formula $$ evaluates to the satisfying sign at $x$ if and only if there is an assignment to $(w-3)||$ auxiliary variables for which the width-three Tseitin transformation evaluates to the satisfying sign on the combined assignment.
